AXIS Franka Dataset
	

The AXIS Franka Dataset is a large-scale robot manipulation dataset collected for research on robot learning, imitation learning, policy training, and embodied AI.
This repository contains the full dataset release for non-commercial academic research and educational use.

Project website: https://axisaiorg.github.io/AXIS-V1/
Code: https://github.com/AxisAIOrg/Axis-V1-Training
Commercial / partnership inquiries: datasets@axisrobotics.ai
